author: Chef Fatty
transcript: Let's make the Lazy Don Don Noodles in under 15 minutes. Cook your noodles then set aside. Crispy ground pork, add soy sauce, garlic, then set aside. Then fry tahini, chili oil, soy sauce, sesame oil, ching-kang vinegar, sugar, green onions. Stir, then add your noodles, ground pork, then serve. Bon appetit!
title: Lazy Dan Dan Noodles in 15 Minutes
one_liner: A quick one-pot dan dan noodle recipe with crispy pork and a tahini-chili sauce.
key_points: Cook noodles and set aside, then crisp up ground pork with soy sauce and garlic
Fry together tahini, chili oil, soy sauce, sesame oil, Chinkiang vinegar, sugar, and green onions
Toss noodles and pork into the sauce and serve immediately
Total cook time is under 15 minutes

instructions: 1. Cook noodles according to package instructions, then set aside.
2. In a pan, cook ground pork until crispy, then add soy sauce and garlic. Set aside.
3. In the same pan, fry tahini, chili oil, soy sauce, sesame oil, Chinkiang vinegar, sugar, and green onions until combined.
4. Add cooked noodles and ground pork into the sauce and stir to coat.
